models.model_label: Future earnings timeliness by beginning-of-period MTB rank
models.sample_description: Compustat–CRSP firm-years over 1972–1999. The base sample requires MTB at year-end t and earnings and returns from t−4 through t+3; it excludes negative-book-value firms and truncates the top/bottom 0.5% of price-deflated annual and long-horizon earnings and returns. models.method_details: Fama–Macbeth cross-sectional estimation is reported; the estimator applied within each annual cross-section is not separately identified.

review_notes: The selected principal family is the paper’s central MTB–asymmetric-timeliness relation: Table 4A tests beginning-of-period MTB rank against future good-news, bad-news, and asymmetric timeliness; Table 5A tests ending-of-period MTB rank against historical timeliness. The horizons are part of these designs.

Tables 2–3 report initial Basu regressions across horizons without MTB rank; Tables 4B–5B are explicitly descriptive extreme-quintile comparisons, and the later goodwill analysis is robustness. These are not the primary regression family selected from the stated objective and hypotheses.

The underlying estimator within each annual Fama–Macbeth cross-section is not identified. Source conflicts in the Eq. (2) denominator/forward-return timing and Eq. (3) horizon range remain flagged; status is needs_review.
results_review_notes: Only the frozen Table 4A forward and Table 5A historical baseline families are extracted. Separate extreme-MTB-quintile Tables 4B/5B and other analyses are outside the selected locations.
All 7 RHS terms and intercepts are extracted for k=1–3 and j=0–4. Reported b1+g1 combinations and adjacent-horizon differences are kept as auxiliary estimates with their own printed t-statistics.

Table 1 summaries are retained for the raw MTB ratio, market value denominator, horizon-matched earnings and returns. Indicator and interaction descriptives are not reported and are not calculated from the raw summaries.
Forward outcome/return timing conflicts and the Table 4A b1+g1 cell/prose discrepancy are documented rather than reconciled.
